title: Monkeys Meet Machines: AI Touchscreens Test Primate Smarts in the Wild
description: Researchers deployed AI-powered touchscreens in a Costa Rican forest to test wild capuchin monkeys' learning abilities with banana rewards. The CapuchinAI device, led by Emory University's Marcela Benítez, lets primates engage on their own terms, yielding insights impossible in labs. Ten of 16 monkeys mastered the task. Upgrades will track individuals and complex cognition. (48 words)

title: Data Center Supply Chains Emerge as AI Buildout's Third Chokepoint, Survey Finds
description: Data center supply chains are now the AI buildout's third critical chokepoint, per a DP World survey of 100 executives: 92% call predictive analytics capabilities critical, but only 29% currently use them — leaving most operators flying blind in a logistics environment where transformer lead times run three to five years.
